text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: O-oh my gosh! What was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's like my power's surging… I feel like I just got way bigger!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This is great! Now that I've gotten even bigger, I can eat even more!
